text_description: Full runway look centered on a black, highly textured tiered ruffle dress with a straight-to-cocoon column silhouette that falls below the knee. The garment covers the torso and arms with dense horizontal layers of frayed, pleated, and fluttering fabric strips, creating pronounced volume around the shoulders, upper body, and hips while narrowing toward the lower skirt. The neckline sits high and is partly obscured by texture and a bold gold spiked collar-style necklace resting around the base of the neck. The sleeves appear long or fully integrated into the ruffled body, with the arms mostly hidden except for one hand emerging at the side. The hem is uneven and softly jagged, with layered black ruffles extending to mid-calf at points and revealing the lower legs. Styling is formal and dramatic: the model carries a small round pale clutch or minaudière with red/pink embellishment in one hand, wears black pointed-toe pumps with a small gold accent at the toe, and has a polished updo with small tinted eyewear visible. The overall palette is predominantly black with metallic gold and pale pink-red accessory accents, giving the look an ornate, couture-like, sculptural mood.
